#### Email Service Provider

* The service responsible for sending emails from your platform. Currently, AWS SES (Amazon Simple Email Service) is available.
* Select from a drop-down list. In this case, choose **AWS SES**.
* If you require integration with a new **Email Service Provider** not listed, email us at [skpintu93@gmail.com](mailto:skpintu93@gmail.com) (this service will incur additional charges).

#### SES Configuration Set Name

* A configuration set in AWS SES is a group of rules that you apply to the emails you send. It helps in tracking and managing email sending activities.
* Enter a text string (e.g., **DefaultConfigSet**). This should match the configuration set name defined in your AWS SES dashboard.

#### From Email

* The sender email address that will appear in outgoing emails. This email is used for all communication sent from your platform.
* Enter a valid email address (e.g., noreply@yourdomain.com). Ensure that the email format is correct.

#### Help URL

* A URL that directs users to a help page or support resource related to email communications.
* Enter a URL-friendly text string (e.g., [https://www.yourdomain.com/support/email-help).](https://www.yourdomain.com/support/email-help\).)
